name: briefed-tray
why: The part's own requirement, judged. 110 x 56.9 x 10.7 against a 95 x 70 x 16 envelope is over by exactly 15 mm along x and by nothing else — the envelope is matched in the best of the six axis orientations, so 56.9 takes the 70 and 10.7 the 16, and a case recording 'over' on y or z would mean that pairing had broken. The verdict is held word for word because it is the sentence a reader meets first. The budget is the measured volume over 1000 — 34.1 cm³ here, where the session's own v5 was 18.2 — so it moves with the geometry rather than with the brief, and both clauses of the verdict come from the build. This is the session's own v5 and its own brief: five designs, six user turns, two of them corrections of a requirement nothing in any reply compared anything to (docs/COIN_HOLDER_REVIEW.md, Appendix C §1).

brief.verdict: over: 110.0 mm along x against a 95 mm envelope; 34.1 cm³ against 12
